text:
Maya Chen: Quick capture from onboarding with ClearPath Health — three asks to log for product.
Maya Chen: 1) Per-route billing export: finance needs a CSV with line items per model+route for reconciliation.
Maya Chen: 2) Evaluation window: their evals show instability at 2k-4k token contexts; want earlier churn detection, smaller sliding window.
Maya Chen: 3) Private model onboarding: customer wants to bring a finetune/adapter but cannot share weights publicly; asks for scoped upload to Dedicated with restricted keys.
Samir Patel: can you paste exact quotes or example CSV? prioritization needs repro + impact estimate.
Diego Rivera: quotes from the call: "If we don't get the export this week we'll need 2 FTEs to do manual mapping" / "the eval noise at long contexts prevents us from moving to 50% pilot" / "we cannot ship model artifacts outside our org"
Elena Park: triage severity: export = S2 (billing/monetization), eval window = S3 (usability), model upload = S1 (deal blocker/compliance).
Liam O'Neill: export MVP idea: CSV header route_id,model_name,request_ts,user_id,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,total_cost_usd. covers 90% of asks. note: ClearPath needs department-code prefix on filenames.
Samir Patel: proposal: 2-week spike to add export endpoint + parallel design doc for model upload. Eng/product estimates?
Diego Rivera: ClearPath is open to pilot pricing to accelerate priority — they'll sign a small add-on.
ProductBot: summary created -> "clearpath-onboard-2026-03-billing-eval-modelupload" :link: https://redwood.company/feedback/board/9876
Elena Park: actions: Maya upload recording + sample CSV; Samir schedule 30-min triage w/eng; Liam draft API contract; Diego confirm pilot price/legal.
Maya Chen: uploading call recording + CSV sample to feedback board by EOD. @Samir please schedule triage tomorrow.
Samir Patel: calendar invite sent. :calendar:
Liam O'Neill: note for eng infra: model upload needs per-model isolation + KMS-scoped keys; will affect infra timeline.
Diego Rivera: will confirm legal constraints on customer models and follow up in thread.
Samir Patel: keeping thread open for PM/CS/Eng updates. drop any additional quotes or artifacts here. :thumbsup:
